title: Mexican Pork Chop Casserole
description: This Mexican pork chop casserole recipe includes rice, tomato sauce, taco seasoning, bell peppers, and Cheddar cheese for an easy-to-assemble meal.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil, or as needed
1 (8 ounce) can tomato sauce, or more to taste
1 red bell pepper, sliced into rings
1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add pork chops, in batches if necessary; cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes. Transfer chops to a 9x13-inch baking dish; season with salt.
Pour rice around chops. Combine water, tomato sauce, and taco seasoning in a bowl; pour over chops and rice. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil.

Bake in the preheated oven until rice is tender and liquid is mostly absorbed, about 1 hour. Remove foil; top with bell pepper and Cheddar cheese. Continue baking until cheese is melted, about 15 minutes more.
